title: Figures 6-7: 3D renderings of cylindrical Tic Tac UAP and metallic spherical UAP
description: Two computer-generated recreations of reported UAP shapes. Figure 6 is a three-dimensional rendering of a white cylindrical or 'Tic Tac' shaped UAP; Figure 7 is a 3D rendering of a reflective metallic spherical UAP hovering over a cobblestone plaza with buildings mirrored on its surface.
